## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behavior changes
- [ ] `npm run ci` passes locally
- [ ] Schema change? `model.ts` and `crates/project/src/lib.rs` updated together, old version still accepted, tests for both paths
- [ ] Text, framing, transition, timing or color change? Verified in both the canvas preview and the FFmpeg export
- [ ] UI change? Screenshot attached below
- [ ] No new network calls, accounts, telemetry, limits or paywalls
- [ ] Not a release (no tag, version bump or GitHub release)
